text:
Noelle_CS: Heads-up — CedarBridge onboarding. Their QA harness will run a cross-region demo and we're seeing repeated 429s on the EU edge. They asked if we can do a short-lived change: pin demo traffic to a dedicated pool in eu-south-1, add a CIDR-based ephemeral allowlist, and raise burst for the window. Renewal review next week so this demo is high priority. Can ops take it? :raised_hands:
Ethan_CSM: This is important — if demo is smooth it directly affects renewal negotiation. Include a 1-line enablement blurb for AE about dedicated pool routing. I'll join the demo on the call.
Priyanka_Ops: I can own the change. Plan: allocate traffic matching header `X-CB-Demo: 1` to dedicated pool `dedicated-12` in eu-south-1, apply CIDR allowlist 198.51.200.0/29 (covers demo runners), bump burst to 1400 rps for a 3.5h window, autorevoke TTL=8h. Fallback region: us-west-2 if p50 > 260ms. Need manual approve and we'll run a pre-warm.
Noelle_CS: Demo traffic will originate from that /29 range. They will set header X-CB-Demo: 1 on demo calls. Also ask CedarBridge to white-label the metrics link for the AE.
Sam_Engineer: Routing to a dedicated pool is supported but we'll need to add a dedicated-pool binding in the customer's routing config. ETA ~35m to push the header-match + pool binding to staging and run a smoke. Will verify token spend delta during smoke.
Ava_SRE: Recommend a KV cache pre-warm 12 minutes prior using synthetic calls that mirror the demo prompt distribution. I'll watch p95 and token cost; rollback criteria: p95 regression >11% OR token cost spike >17% during warmup. Also suggest temporary alerting to #ops-watches for the window.
Priyanka_Ops: I'll schedule pre-warm at T-12m and apply config at T=demo start. Also will set the allowlist TTL so it auto-revokes 8h after window_end. Can someone paste the exact snippet I'll apply so AE and CedarBridge ops have the config?
Sam_Engineer: Pasting planned config below — applying at 2025-08-20T14:00:00Z (local 16:00 CEST). Queueing for manual approval by Priyanka_Ops.
```
# change_id: 3219876543-cedarbridge-dedicated-pin
customer: "cedarbridge"
change_id: "3219876543-dedicated"
allowlist_cidr: "198.51.200.0/29"
route_to: {pool: "dedicated-12", region: "eu-south-1"}
rate_limit: {burst_rps: "1400", window_start: "2025-08-20T14:00:00Z", window_end: "2025-08-20T17:30:00Z", autorevoke_ttl: "8h"}
routing_match: {header: "X-CB-Demo", value: "1", primary_region: "eu-south-1", fallback: "us-west-2", fallback_latency_ms: "260"}
notes: "Dedicated pool pin for demo; pre-warm KV cache at T-12m; alerts to ops-watches"
```
Sam_Engineer: That snippet is what I'll push to staging and then to prod after approval. Will post smoke results (p50/p95, 5xx, token delta) here.
Ava_SRE: I'll run the warmup and short-lived alerting. If warmup shows regressions we'll revoke immediately and notify.
Priyanka_Ops: Approving now. Pre-warm scheduled 13:48Z, apply at 14:00Z. I'll run the manual approve in the console and post the change request id.
deploy-bot: change_request cedarbridge-3219876543 queued for manual approval by Priyanka_Ops at 2025-08-20T13:40:00Z
Priyanka_Ops: Approved and queued. Sam, please post staging smoke and then live smoke once applied. I'll capture CedarBridge PM feedback post-demo and put a short note in the renewal tracker: "CedarBridge demo routed to dedicated pool + ephemeral CIDR allowlist; success de-risks renewal."
Noelle_CS: Thanks team — please @channel any major regressions. I'll collect PM/AE feedback and paste notes here afterwards.
